name: Kinetic Captions
tagline: One giant word at a time. Yellow highlights on the words that matter.
description: Vertical social style for talking-head clips, hooks and tips. Each spoken word slams in big and centered, key words get a yellow highlighter block, a progress bar runs along the bottom and a sticker lands for the takeaway.

caption.usage: Captions 230px uppercase, one word (max two) per beat

transitions: hard word swaps (one clip per word)

rhythm.notes: Match word clips to speech: 0.6–1.1s each. Hold the final line ~2.5s.

guide:
- 1080×1920. Keep captions centered at y≈760 so they clear the platform UI at the top and bottom.
- One clip per word (class="clip", data-start/data-duration from the transcript). Pop each with scale 1.45→1, opacity 0→1, 0.18s back.out(3).
- Highlight 1–2 keywords per sentence with the yellow #ffe600 block (dark text, 18px radius). Never highlight more than one word per beat.
- Shake (x ±8, 0.05s yoyo) only on the emotional peak word.
- Keep the creator handle top-left and a thin yellow progress bar along the bottom for the full duration.
- Land the takeaway as a tilted pink sticker in the last 2 seconds.
